ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) across the visible ventral surface; high-intensity pixels are restricted to edge specular highlights and localized surface glare.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark, low-intensity pigmentation across both visible lobes; no distinct high-contrast contiguous geometric blobs or mottling patterns are detectable.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; multiple sharp peaks and U-shaped valleys are prominent, with varying pixel-amplitudes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broad convex trajectory sweeping from the median notch to the distal tips; both lobes exhibit a continuous upward-curving arc.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular indentation visible on the trailing edge of the right lobe, positioned approximately one-third of the distance from the median notch to the lateral tip.
